title: Three Saturdays and One Short Crate
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：goods　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 goods 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 the trader ① counted the goods that no partner in the market would have described, and he said the counting was the whole of the Saturday. The ② goods, meaning the stock itself and not the coins, ran three Saturdays and stayed undescribed in the book; goods, he said, is the only thing in a market that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ kind of goods in that market had the same short crate beside it, and the ④ goods at the far stall, meaning the lot they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Goods, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the trader said the describing is the part that fills three Saturdays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the goods was the whole of the matter, meaning the worth and not the stock. The ⑥ goods, meaning the worth and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; goods, he said, is either something you count or the only word that means both a stock and a worth. He said the worth is the part they remember.

By 1980 the ⑦ goods had become a line in a ledger, and the ledger had become an argument about the short crate. The ⑧ goods of the whole thing, the trader wrote in November, was one market and three Saturdays of describing; goods, he said, is either the lot at the far stall or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ goods I remember is the goods described in the ledger, which closed in 1982 and is still described as the quietest in the market. ⑩ Goods, my mother said in 1984, is the only stock that improves by being described; all goods, she said, is a worth that has agreed to look like a stock. She said the worth was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 商品；货物（指集市上每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 商品；货物（指那批货本身，与钱币相对）
C. 固定搭配：count the goods 清点货物
D. n. 商品（指留给孩子们学着卖的那批）
E. n. 货物（抽象总称，指一处集市的买卖之事）
F. n. 商品（指账簿里写到、被记下的那批）
G. n. 财物；所有物（指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 家当（抽象总称，指人人都守却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: counted the goods that no partner in the market would have described
The goods, meaning the stock itself and not the coins
Every kind of goods in that market
the goods at the far stall
the goods was the whole of the matter
the goods had become a line in a ledger
The goods of the whole thing

answers.why: count the goods 意为“清点货物”，1975 年那位商人清点了集市上没有一位同伴肯描述的那批货。
goods 意为“商品、货物”，指那批货本身而不是钱币，它经过了三个星期六而在簿子上没有被描述。
goods 意为“商品、货物”，指集市上每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一只矮矮的板条箱。
goods 意为“商品”，指最远那个摊子上留给孩子们学着卖的那批，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
goods 意为“财物、所有物”，指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份家当就是那件事的全部。
goods 意为“家当”，指人人都守却无人提起的那样东西而不是那批货，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
goods 意为“商品”，指账簿里写到、被记下的那批，到 1980 年这批成了账簿里的一行。
goods 意为“货物”，商人十一月写道，整件事的买卖之事是一处集市和三个星期六的描述。
goods 意为“商品”，我记得的是账簿里描述过的那批，1982 年卖完了，至今仍被说成集市里最安静的一批。
goods 为抽象总称，母亲 1984 年说，货物是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的东西。
